workLog.finding: The PR branch copilot/fix-pr-autofix-tier-issue carries one commit titled 'Initial plan' and an empty diff against its merge base. git diff --name-only origin/main...origin/copilot/fix-pr-autofix-tier-issue returns nothing. The PR body describes a completed fix, a regenerated mirror, and a new test, none of which were ever pushed; the body itself notes the local push was blocked by a sandbox network restriction on the security-scan pre-push hook.

workLog.activity: Verified the described defect still exists on main
workLog.finding: .claude/commands/pr-autofix.md read '.Data.Tier' from test_pr_merge_ready.py. That script has no --output-format flag and emits its result dict directly via print(json.dumps(result, indent=2)), so there is no Data envelope. TIER was pinned at UNKNOWN, silently disabling the T3/T4 round-cap circuit breaker and the non-T1 auto-merge disarm gate.

workLog.activity: Applied the fix and regenerated the mirror
workLog.finding: Changed the read to '.Tier' in .claude/commands/pr-autofix.md and regenerated src/copilot-cli/skills/pr-autofix/SKILL.md with build/scripts/generate_commands.py. Regeneration touched only the intended file.

Statically binds all 16 jq reads in the command body to their producer scripts, derives each producer's real output shape with ast, and fails on any envelope-level or field-name mismatch. Envelope detection keys off the github_core.output emitter call rather than a Success field, because flat producers can carry their own top-level Success key (test_pr_merge_ready.py does).

All 16 reads bind to a producer with zero unbound. The other 15 were already correct: 13 Data-wrapped reads against check_pr_live_state.py, pr_autofix_lease.py, check_pr_round_cap.py, and get_pr_context.py, plus a flat '.merged' read against test_pr_merged.py.

The bot correctly found the first gate did not catch the defect issue #5094 reported: field names were checked only for flat producers, so `.Data.tier` from check_pr_live_state.py passed clean. Extended derivation to wrapped producers by unioning keys across every write_skill_output/write_skill_error payload. Also had to teach _keys_bound_to about ast.AnnAssign, since get_pr_context.py builds its payload that way and an Assign-only walk would have failed the valid `.Data.auto_merge_method` read as a phantom field. Closed two further gaps: multi-path jq programs, and a coverage guard that shared the extractor's regex and so went blind in lockstep with it.

deliverables.description: Tier read corrected from .Data.Tier to .Tier, re-arming the T3/T4 round-cap circuit breaker and the non-T1 auto-merge disarm gate
Generated Copilot mirror refreshed via build/scripts/generate_commands.py so the shipped plugin carries the same fix
Static contract gate binding every jq read in the command body to its producer's ast-derived output shape; 22 tests including negative controls for both envelope-mismatch directions

patterns.pattern: Derive a producer's output schema statically and check consumers against it
patterns.context: Shell command bodies read producer JSON through jq. A wrong path yields null, the // default fires, and the gate silently passes with no evidence.
patterns.application: Parse the producer with ast to determine envelope level and top-level keys, then fail the build on any consumer read that disagrees.

avoidances.antipattern: Trusting a PR body's description of completed work without reading the diff
avoidances.consequence: PR #5175's body described a fix, a regenerated mirror, and a new test against a branch whose diff was empty. Reviewing the prose would have approved nothing.
avoidances.correction: Check git diff against the merge base before reading the description.

avoidances.antipattern: Using a Success field to detect the Data envelope
avoidances.consequence: test_pr_merge_ready.py emits a flat object that carries its own top-level Success key, so a Success probe misclassifies it as enveloped and the check inverts.
avoidances.correction: Key envelope detection off the github_core.output emitter call, which is the thing that actually wraps the payload.

avoidances.antipattern: Fixing a silent-fallback bug at the instance instead of the class
avoidances.consequence: The issue #5094 repair moved the read to the right producer but kept the wrong envelope, reproducing the identical silent-UNKNOWN defect one script over.
avoidances.correction: Ship a gate covering every read of the same shape, not only the one that was reported.

avoidances.antipattern: Building a coverage guard on the same regex as the thing it guards
avoidances.consequence: test_extractor_reaches_every_jq_invocation first reused _JQ_PROGRAM. Mutating that pattern to match nothing blinded the extractor and the guard together, so the guard passed vacuously and certified the blindness it exists to catch.
avoidances.correction: Detect with an independent, weaker pattern (_JQ_TOKEN spots the word jq). Prove the decoupling by re-running the mutation and watching the guard fail.
